summary: The patch correctly gates the remaining icon-link hover translation on a fine pointer and no reduced-motion preference; panel, card, and button hover rules no longer contain transforms at base, and color and focus feedback remain unchanged.

evidence: public/styles.css:316-321 places the only remaining hover transform, the icon-arrow translateX(3px), behind (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) and (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference), so reduced-motion users receive no icon-link movement.

At the base, the panel/project/dashboard-section and button hover rules at public/styles.css:1096-1125 change only shadows, borders, and colors; no hover transforms remain for panels, cards, or buttons.

Fine-pointer users without the reduced-motion preference still receive the icon-arrow translation, while button hover colors at public/styles.css:301-304 and focus-visible outlines at public/styles.css:323-329 remain outside the motion gate.
